source.label: Recorded from a local gateway run, not the live API. Every line is a real request or a real response.

steps.note: Which tools exist and what each call costs. Discovery is public; nothing here can be invoked yet.
steps.title: The agent reads the manifest.

steps.note: One tool, one agent identity, a budget, an expiry, signed by the operator's key. The agent cannot mint this for itself.
steps.title: The operator issues one scoped permit.

steps.note: The gateway dispatches, debits the scoped budget, and returns a signed receipt that names the permit and the ledger entry.
steps.title: The call executes and is charged once.

steps.note: Same receipt id, no second dispatch, no second debit. A timed-out client can retry without fear.
steps.title: The same idempotency key comes back.

steps.note: The SDK verifier checks the Ed25519 signature against the published key set. It never imports the gateway.
